mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a weakening demand environment, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 70% of the instances when RSAFS is declining.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO > 1% YoY growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp and PAYEMS increases > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp and PAYEMS increases > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressure with accommodative monetary policy, which boosts equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL > 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST > 5% YoY growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals supply-side constraints with inflationary pressure, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO < -1% YoY and CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY.
